prompt: How many times in the history of the Summer Olympic Games has the United States not topped the medal table?
answer:
The United States has **not topped the Summer Olympic medal table 11 times**.

Those Games were: **1900, 1908, 1936, 1956, 1960, 1972, 1976, 1980, 1988, 1992, and 2008**.

This counts all 30 Summer Olympics from 1896 through 2024. The U.S. topped the table 19 times; it did not compete in 1980 because of the boycott, so among Games in which it participated, it failed to finish first **10 times**.
